This article is a stub. Thrifty Timing was a dealer in swim timing equipment in Eau Claire,
Wisconsin, that advertised the [Kyroscope pace clock](../equipment/common/pace-clock/kyroscope-pace-clock.md)
from 1974, along with Kyroscope timers and [Accusplit](accusplit.md) and [Cronus](cronus.md)
stopwatches.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
